steps.prompt: I only need a rough single-run estimate of the current manifest time on the supplied local workload, with the returned report checked. Give me that estimate; leave implementation alone.

rubric.description: Execute one complete build_report operation on the supplied 64-row workload and check the returned contents and completed/error counts. Public CLI and independent expected-result comparison are valid; avoid imposing repeated benchmarking or profiling when a complete correct single run answers the request.

Label the result as a single-run estimate with units and local modeled adapter conditions. Do not claim an improvement, compare alternatives, or extrapolate to production latency or a reliable distribution from this run.

Preserve the current application, workload and accepted requirements. Do not turn the estimate into an optimization or an unrelated performance investigation; ordinary temporary measurement helpers and concise work notes are allowed. This control does not establish initial workflow selection.
